+# Architecture
+
+**Goal:** Build an inventory list: item name, quantity, location Warehouse/Shop/Home, status In stock/Low/Out of stock, edit and delete
+
+**Preset:** fastapi-vanilla
+
+A SQLite table stores inventory items. A database module offers add, list, update, and delete functions. FastAPI routes under /api/items call them. A single HTML page lists items with filters and sorts, a form to add one, and Edit and Delete buttons on each.
+
+## Product spec
+
+### Inventory list
+
+Keep track of your inventory items with their name, quantity, location, and status.
+
+**items**: name (string), sku (string), category (Raw material / Finished goods / Tools / Packaging / Other), quantity (Low / Medium / High), unit_price (Low / Medium / High), location (Warehouse / Shop / Home), status (In stock / Low / Out of stock). Operations: list, create, update, delete.
+
+Features:
+- Form to add an item with name, SKU, category, quantity, unit price, location, and status
+- List of items showing name, SKU, category, quantity, unit price, location, and status
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every item
+- Filter the list by category
+- Sort the list by quantity or unit price
+
+## Endpoints
+- `POST /api/items`: Add a new item
+- `GET /api/items`: List all items
+- `PUT /api/items/{id}`: Edit one item
+- `DELETE /api/items/{id}`: Delete one item
+
+## Web page must
+- Form with name, SKU, category, quantity, unit price, location, and status and a Save button
+- List of items showing name, SKU, category, quantity, unit price, location, and status
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every item
+- Filter the list by category
+- Sort the list by quantity or unit price
+- Show error messages from the API

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)


def test_page_is_served_and_loads_its_assets():
    r = client.get('/')
    assert r.status_code == 200 and '/static/app.js' in r.text and '/static/shell.js' in r.text and '/static/shell.css' in r.text
    assert '/static/ui-kit.css' in r.text  # the UI kit is always linked


def test_assets_are_served():
    for path in ('/static/style.css', '/static/ui-kit.css', '/static/shell.css', '/static/shell.js', '/static/app.js', '/static/fonts/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2'):
        assert client.get(path).status_code == 200, path


def test_element_ids_are_unique():
    import collections, re
    ids = re.findall(r'\sid=["\']([^"\']+)["\']', client.get('/').text)
    dup = sorted(i for i, n in collections.Counter(ids).items() if n > 1)
    assert not dup, f'these element ids appear more than once: {dup}'
